The fix in `caddyconfig/caddyfile/lexer.go:206` (matching the upstream Caddy v2.7.6 fix for this exact issue):

- **`<<` followed by a space** is now treated as a regular token (`return makeToken(0)`), so `between << >>` lexes as `<<` and `>>` instead of attempting heredoc parsing.
- The "too many `<`" check moved to only trigger when a newline follows a `<<<` prefix (a real heredoc attempt), so `<<<EOF content` on one line is a plain token.
- Added a "missing opening heredoc marker" error for bare `<<` at end of line.
- Guarded the heredoc detection with `!(quoted || btQuoted)` for safety.

Verified with `go test ./caddyconfig/caddyfile/...` — including the new FAIL_TO_PASS lexer cases (`not-a-heredoc << >>`, `<<HERE SAME LINE`, `<<<EOF content`, `\<< >>`) and all pre-existing heredoc/error cases.
